doc.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025

title: Opening: Liebman's quote about Marino's playing
summary: Monk Rowe welcomes Marino and opens with a Dave Liebman quote; Marino credits his off-the-cuff responsiveness.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have bassist Tony Marino with me today. Welcome, sir.

It’s a pleasure to have you. I’d like to start out with a quote I read that I’m going to use a blank for the name. It was from Dave Liebman. Dave Liebman said, “I may have said three words to blank about how or what to play. He’s the most distinctive musician I have known.” Who do you think Dave was talking about?
Well just, I guess my ability off-the-cuff and to respond basically. You know nothing stellar but definitely I have my moments. You know?
